project.name: Owen County Schools Upgrades & Athletics
project.description: Level 1 Digital Twin Shell for Owen County Schools Upgrades & Athletics (Job #3620251, $15.9M). Managed by Devere Construction under TCS doctrine. Currently in review-only posture with 11 gates defined (A0-D2), 2 shell-ready and 9 blocked. The shell establishes project identity, source chain, gate readiness matrix, and stop rules without authorizing any live project action.

nodes.name: AGENT_BOOT.md
nodes.summary: Agent initialization file that defines the project mission (bring Owen County online as Level 1 Twin Shell), establishes the non-inheritance rule from UK CAER, documents project identity (name, number, owner, architect, CM, PM, address), defines the 6-rank authority stack from executed contracts down to chats/screenshots, prescribes the required read order for the next agent, and sets hard stop rules against any live project mutation.

nodes.name: DOCTRINE__ALTITUDE_MESH_OPERATING_SYSTEM.md
nodes.summary: The Altitude Mesh Operating System doctrine authored by Pro (VP1 seat). Defines the 6-layer altitude stack (subatomic, micro, meso, macro, VP exec rollup, founder), three event classes for upward signal flow (work events to meso, state events to macro, ratification events broadcast), the PASP upward-wake gate, reporting cadences from continuous to weekly, structured report shapes for each altitude boundary (micro-to-meso, meso-to-macro, macro-to-VP), downward order shapes (macro intent, meso decomposition, micro execution, subatomic command), and the Keystone Law of hard edges with soft interior.

nodes.name: GATE_READINESS.md
nodes.summary: Defines the 11-gate readiness matrix (A0 Project Identity through D2 Owner/External View). Gates A0 and A1 are shell-ready; gates A2 through D2 are blocked. Documents what agents may do without approval (read, build inventories, flag conflicts) vs what requires Michael's approval (send emails, submit RFIs, change Sage, pass gates). Defines 7 validation states (cited, inferred, validated, disputed, stale, superseded, not_authority), required fields for gate movement, and a receipt template.

nodes.name: SOURCE_MAP.md
nodes.summary: Registers all inputs read for the Level 1 shell including 10 source documents from the bring-online packet and overlay snapshot. Maps the live OneDrive project folder structure (17 folders from PreConstruction through Close Out plus Issues, HERMES_INBOX, TCS_OVERLAY). Identifies 8 system-of-record candidates (contract, Sage, submittals, RFIs, schedule, safety, correspondence, PM actions) with their current disputed/missing states. Lists 8 first control questions and 6 categories of missing source evidence.

nodes.name: TWIN_STATE.md
nodes.summary: Documents the current Level 1 readiness (identity, source map, gate posture, stop rules all present). Records project identity with fact states. Registers 8 twin object families (Project, ProjectGate, ProjectTwinState, Zone, EvidenceToken, ApprovalBoundary, ActionRecord, RiskRecord). Contains the 9-item P0/P1 validation queue seed covering submittal conflicts, RFI conflicts, overdue checklists, change management splits, safety gaps, DPO reconciliation, schedule freshness, PM transition, and cleanpoint staleness. Tracks 6 systems (Sage, OneDrive, Submittal Exchange, Outlook, schedule files, TCS overlay) and prescribes the next safe load sequence.

tours.name: Project Onboarding Tour
tours.description: Walk through the Owen County Level 1 Digital Twin Shell in the prescribed read order, from agent initialization through source chain to operational governance.

stops.title: 1. Agent Boot — Start Here
stops.narration: AGENT_BOOT.md is the entry point for any agent working on Owen County. It establishes the project as Job #3620251 ($15.9M Owen County Schools Upgrades & Athletics), sets the non-inheritance rule from UK CAER, documents project identity fields with their fact states, and defines a 6-rank authority stack from executed contracts (Rank 1) down to chats and screenshots (Rank 6). Critically, it sets the review-only posture: no emails, no RFIs, no Sage mutations, no live folder changes without explicit approval.

stops.title: 2. Source Map — What Was Read
stops.narration: SOURCE_MAP.md registers the 10 source documents read for Level 1 and maps the live OneDrive folder structure (17 project folders). It identifies 8 system-of-record candidates and flags conflicts: submittal counts conflict across Sage, Submittal Exchange, and OneDrive; RFI counts/status conflict; Sage snapshot is dated March 2026. Six categories of source evidence are explicitly marked as missing.

stops.title: 3. Altitude Mesh Doctrine — The Operating System
stops.narration: The Doctrine defines how signals flow through the TCS organism. Six altitude layers (subatomic through founder) with three event classes (work, state, ratification) and the PASP upward-wake gate that prevents macro from waking every time micro sneezes. Cadences range from continuous receipts to twice-daily VP rollups to weekly manifests. Downward orders translate through four layers: macro intent, meso decomposition, micro execution, subatomic command.

stops.title: 4. Gate Readiness — The 11-Gate Matrix
stops.narration: GATE_READINESS.md defines 11 gates from A0 (Project Identity) through D2 (Owner/External View). Only A0 and A1 are shell-ready; all others are blocked by missing source evidence. The file draws a bright line between what agents may do autonomously (read, inventory, flag) and what requires Michael's approval (send, submit, change, pass). Seven validation states track fact confidence.

stops.title: 5. Twin State — Current Digital Twin Status
stops.narration: TWIN_STATE.md confirms Level 1 readiness: identity, source map, gate posture, and stop rules all present. It registers 8 object families, tracks a 9-item validation queue of P0/P1 items (submittal conflicts, RFI conflicts, overdue checklists, change management splits, safety gaps), maps 6 systems, and prescribes the next safe load sequence for advancing to Level 2.

tours.name: Gate Readiness Tour
tours.description: Walk through each of the 11 gates in the A0-D2 matrix showing current readiness state, blockers, and required evidence to advance.

stops.title: Gate Overview — Shell-Ready vs Blocked
stops.narration: Of 11 gates, 2 are shell-ready (A0 Project Identity, A1 Source Chain) and 9 are blocked. No gate has been passed — this is by design for a Level 1 shell. Every gate passage requires human approval, source evidence, and a receipt.

stops.title: A0 Project Identity — Shell Ready
stops.narration: A0 is shell-ready: project name, number, owner, architect, CM, and address are all cited from the packet. Blocker: current live authority not verified against executed contract or Sage identity record. Required to advance: executed contract or approved project record.

stops.title: A1 Source Chain — Shell Ready
stops.narration: A1 is shell-ready: the source map registers all packet inputs and the live folder path. Blocker: live originals not re-inventoried on the target machine. Required to advance: current folder inventory and source authority receipt.

stops.title: A2-B3 Commercial & Schedule Gates — Blocked
stops.narration: A2 (Contract Posture), B1 (Sage/Commercial), B2 (Schedule), and B3 (Procurement/DPO) are all blocked. The executed contract, NTP, current CO posture, live Sage, baseline schedule, and DPO reconciliation have not been read. These are the commercial foundation gates.

stops.title: C1-C3 Field Execution Gates — Blocked
stops.narration: C1 (Submittals/RFIs) is blocked by count/status conflicts across systems. C2 (Safety/Quality) is blocked by unknown currentness of safety exposure. C3 (Field Execution) is blocked because the current work plan and next-14-days forecast are unknown. These are the field-truth gates.

stops.title: D1-D2 PM & Owner Gates — Blocked
stops.narration: D1 (PM Operating Cadence) is blocked because the action register and correspondence have not been validated. D2 (Owner/External View) is blocked pending Michael's explicit approval for any owner/client reliance upgrade. These are the governance gates — they unlock only after all upstream evidence is current.
